Excluding s=1/3 and s=1 eliminates NS low-order resonances; a symbolic center-manifold conjugacy gives Re(conj(lambda) C)=-(s+3)^3/(s+1)^2<0, hence a supercritical invariant circle via the classical NS theorem. Asymptotic amplitude and mean follow from the radial normal form. The standalone packaged verifier reproduces seven symbolic identities and direct-map Fourier samples. No global assertion or higher-order resonance classification is made.
